name: agent-hud
description: One HUD for Codex, Claude Code, Cursor and Antigravity

interface.shortDescription: A shared HUD for four agent CLIs.
interface.longDescription: Agent HUD uses one event model and inherited shell-HUD design across Codex, Claude Code, Cursor and Antigravity. It configures each host's supported native surface and adds an optional live activity companion.
interface.defaultPrompt: Set up Agent HUD for this Codex installation.
